title: 2027 Mo Ibrahim Foundation Leadership Fellowship Program
institution: African Development Bank (with the Mo Ibrahim Foundation)
about: Twelve-month Ibrahim Leadership Fellowship in the executive offices of the African Development Bank in Abidjan, for African nationals with a master's degree and seven or more years of experience. Applications are open until 20 November 2026.
requirements: African nationals; dual nationality not accepted (one nationality must be declared)
Master's degree and at least seven years of relevant experience
Age limit 40, or 45 for women with children
Government officials, active military personnel and political party leaders are excluded
Online form with detailed CV, academic transcripts and three recommendation letters

upskill.name: AI for Leaders Academy
why: "Field: Development policy, leadership" (fellowship in the AfDB executive offices) → "Understand how AI is changing jobs, professional skills, responsibilities, team structures, and the distribution of work across organizations." (A006.06, Leading People in the Age of AI)
No single course objective covers the stated eligibility requirements (master's degree, seven years of experience), so the post links to the AI for Leaders Academy page rather than a specific course.
